entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
(The event) which causes the heart to tremble.
What is that (event) which causes the heart to tremble?
And what have you understood what is (the event) which causes the heart to tremble?
The Day when people will be like scattered moths.
And mountains will be like scattered particles of wool.
So, as for the one whose scales (of good deeds) are heavy.
And as for the one whose scales (of good deeds) are light.
He is in the lap of the one which causes disgrace.
And what have you understood what is the causer of disgrace?
